items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: He had a Mordecai or Bodat on the bass, you know.

ctx.x: Let's see. And the sax set from Lucia goes into... Kiodori did that. And blues for Jimmy on the Columbia record.
He had a Mordecai or Bodat on the bass, you know.

Those guys listen to opera. Bechet used to go down. Oh, yeah. The jazz musicians here. Obviously, they listen to opera. Oh, of course. And of course, we had that French opera here, which presented all kind of opera. You know, many of the famous Italian operas had their premiere at the French opera.
